audit.summary: The core loop works: cubes drop, get collected and pay cash, there are no server errors, and rebirth succeeded once in round 2. However, the game has a seeded TotalEarned/leaderboard bug, shop Buy buttons that do not fire, several acceptance-check counters that never appear, and tutorial and economy oddities.

anomalies.title: TotalEarned seeded at ~1 trillion
anomalies.expected: A new player starts near $0 on the TOP TYCOONS board and the value grows with real earnings.
anomalies.observed: Round 1 reports the board showing $1T for a new player. Round 2 reports $1T cash again, so the bad seed persists across rounds. The board is meaningless and likely corrupts the saved data.

anomalies.title: Shop Buy buttons do not fire (Gold Ore, Cash x1.5)
anomalies.expected: Pressing Buy on an affordable card fires the server purchase, deducts the cost and increments shop_purchases.
anomalies.observed: In round 1 the Buy presses on Card_mult1 and Card_tier_gold show fired=false, and the judge notes the buttons do not fire. In round 2 the judge again reports the Gold tier Buy does not fire. Round 1 still shows shop_purchases=3, and round 2 shows 5, so some purchases do go through. The failure is specific to certain cards and happens in both rounds.

anomalies.title: Pad purchase did not trigger on touch
anomalies.expected: Touching the Cash x1.5 pad with enough cash buys it through the same validation as the shop.
anomalies.observed: Round 1 reports that touching the Cash x1.5 upgrade pad did not buy it. The shop path and the pad path may not share validation or state.

anomalies.title: Acceptance-check counters never appear
anomalies.expected: Counters such as pad_denied, and the shop's tween/sound counters, increment when those actions happen. rebirth_denied is recorded as 5 and 8, and the shop opens 2 and 4 times, so denied actions are being exercised.
anomalies.observed: pad_denied never appears in either round. Only the generic 'highlights' (8 and 12) and 'pad_highlighted' (1) counters exist. The denial feedback for a pad touched while poor is therefore unverified, and pads appear to be bought with enough cash.

anomalies.title: Rebirth gives no feedback when unaffordable and cost doubles
anomalies.expected: Pressing REBIRTH while unaffordable shows a clear denial message, and the cost curve is sensible.
anomalies.observed: rebirth_denied is 5 in round 1 and 8 in round 2, yet the judge reports no visible feedback on denial. Only a small HUD line, 'Need $N more', changes. After the round 2 rebirth the cost jumps from $5000 to $10.0K. Cash resets to 54 and income drops from +$32/s to +$25/s, which is a modest reward for losing every unlock.

anomalies.title: Tutorial re-shown repeatedly
anomalies.expected: The tutorial shows once, and tutorial_done fires once.
anomalies.observed: tutorial_reshown is 6 in both rounds, while tutorial_done is 2 and tutorial_steps is 2. The tutorial keeps being re-triggered.

anomalies.title: Cash pacing is much faster than the pad costs
anomalies.expected: The next purchase is reachable in 15-40 s, with costs growing steadily.
anomalies.observed: The shop prices are $10, $22, $150, $300, $1300 and $2200. Cash reaches 1.1K-4K within minutes, and unspent cash piles up (Cash 4K while upgrades are still available). Round 1 ends with goal_met=false, and the rebirth at 5000 is reached in round 2 with the shop's upgrades already owned.

anomalies.expected: The REBIRTH panel or flow is covered by UI testing.
anomalies.observed: ui_coverage in both rounds lists the REBIRTH gap: its panel was never opened, even though the RebirthGui button was pressed. The coverage surfaces are inconsistent and mis-labelled: the 'Owned' surface appears as a named panel, and Owned buttons were pressed.

conclusion.root_cause: In ShopUi.client.luau, tryBuy has no check for an unmet requirement. It only handles the owned case, the debounce, and the insufficient-cash branch, which is the only direct ShopFx.buyFail call. The other buyFail call is a 2-second pending-buy timeout. A card whose requirement is not owned (button text 'Locked (needs ...)') therefore falls through when the player has enough cash. The client fires BuyUpgrade, the server rejects it, and the player gets no immediate shake, buzz or toast. The probe confirmed that locked cards exist (mult1, tier_gold, dropper4, mult2 and tier_diamond all show 'Locked (needs X)'), and refresh() already computes the requirement state but tryBuy ignores it. I did not trigger a buy on a locked card to watch the silent failure directly.
conclusion.evidence: The tryBuy source has one direct buyFail call, in the cash < u.cost branch, plus the 2-second pending timeout. It has no u.requires / ownedSet[u.requires] check. The client probe listed cards with 'Locked (needs Silver Ore)', 'Locked (needs Dropper 3)', 'Locked (needs Cash x1.5)' and 'Locked (needs Gold Ore)'. Each of these buttons has Active=true and goes through tryBuy.
conclusion.fix_hint: In tryBuy, after the owned check and before the cash check, add: if u.requires and not ownedSet[u.requires] then card.button.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.bad; task.delay(0.25, refresh); ShopFx.buyFail(card.frame); return end. This gives a locked card its own buyFail call (shake, buzz, toast) and returns before the remote fires.

conclusion.root_cause: In CashInService's cash-in handler, the milestone burst block is gated on `burstInfo = info`, the collector found by findCollector/scanForCollectors. The check cashes in 101 times at a bare position, so no registered collector part exists (or none is near it) and `info` stays nil. The whole block is then skipped, including `GameAssets.burst`, even though milestone counts 1/10/50/100 are computed correctly (`MILESTONES[total]`). GameAssets.burst exists and is a function, so the burst depends only on the collector lookup. Milestones are supposed to always burst. This conclusion comes from reading the code and confirming GameAssets.burst exists. I did not directly probe that `info` is nil.
conclusion.evidence: A probe showed GameAssets exposes burst:function. The source read shows `local burstInfo = info; if burstInfo and (milestone or gate(lastBurstAt, player)) then ... GameAssets.burst(burstInfo.part.Position ...)`. The milestone computation (`MILESTONES[total]`, with total as the per-player sentTotal count) runs before this and is unconditional.
